description: This Java class 'KeyboardCondenser' is responsible for adjusting the sizes and positions of keyboard keys in an Android soft keyboard, supporting features like condensing keys to save space and splitting the keyboard layout.

classes.name: KeyboardCondenser
classes.description: Main class for condensing and adjusting keyboard keys layout.

classes.name: KeySize
classes.description: Inner class representing the size and position of a key.

methods.name: KeyboardCondenser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the condenser with context and keyboard.

methods.name: setCondensedKeys
methods.description: Adjusts the keys layout based on condense type and dimensions.

methods.name: splitKeys
methods.description: Splits and condenses keys on the keyboard into two sections.

methods.name: stackRightSideKeyForLater
methods.description: Stacks right side keys for later processing during condensation.

methods.name: condenseLeftSide
methods.description: Condenses and positions a key on the left side.

methods.name: condenseRightSide
methods.description: Condenses and positions keys on the right side.
